I'll contribute some fishing knowledge.
Fishing rivers and creeks should be done primarily around deeper pools of water and natural eddies in a current. The majority of the fish you catch should be of the larger species such as striper bass, catfish, walleye, and so on. The trick is to best present a minnow like lure that best mimicks their actions and behaviors. For Catfish you should panfish first in order to get the desired baitfish. Then use them as bait for said fish. It works best if they are recently dead too.
Some survival forums are advocating getting the rocket fishing rod but in truth, these are a terrible addition to your bag. it is best to get a 5 foot 6 medium action pole that breaks down into 2 parts. Use spider wire as it tends to be smaller than conventional mono-filament and can support heavier weights.
